dedupe_keys.name: solar energetic particle forecasting with multi task deep learning

description: SEPNET estimates next-day energetic-proton event probability through multi-task deep learning. It combines recent SHARP magnetic features with flare information and returns probability, uncertainty and an all-clear indicator. The resource is documented by University of MIchigan. The documented physical domain is Solar, Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository, Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Historical training and timely availability of magnetogram and flare inputs limit prospective application. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
